newsitem.title: USA: U.S. distillate stocks up 0.6 mln bbl on year ago.
newsitem.headline: U.S. distillate stocks up 0.6 mln bbl on year ago.

text.p: Despite bitterly cold weather, U.S. distillate stocks were up 600,000 barrels at the end of last week compared with a year ago, the Energy Information Administration said Wednesday.
Distillate stocks, including heating oil and diesel, were "almost normal" at 125.8 million barrels for the week ending January 10, EIA said in its weekly distillate watch.
"Although the weather has moved fiercely into severe winter patterns during the first full week of the new year, distillate stocks have not yet shown any remarkable draw-downs," the agency said.
Inventories in the Northeast at 47.8 million barrels were 1.4 million barrels down from a year ago.
But in the Midwest stocks were 2.0 million barrels higher than a year ago at 32.8 million barrels, and on the Gulf Coast stocks were 1.5 million barrels higher at 30.3 million barrels, EIA said.
U.S. distillate production stood at 3.3 million barrels per day at the end of last week, off about 170,000 barrels per day from the previous week largely due to a drop in heating oil output.
